page.overview:
Who is Deremi?

Captain Deremi is a male dwarf with salt and pepper hair smooth on top and a smooth beard that comes to a little golden ring at the bottom that has a little tuft at the end of it. He wears the buttoned-over uniform of a captain of the Dwendalian Empire which has a number of decorations on the front of the lapel.

Fjord introduced himself to Captain Deremi at the party at the Marquis Demesne in Nicodranas. Deremi was marginally polite, and seemed to see that Fjord was not as experienced as he was attempting to project.
